'''2015 MPC Andrew Bollentino LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Bollentino]] at [[2015 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Andrew Bollentino]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open WYS Bollentino LS 2015 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
